comments.content:
Having walls that have yet to be repaired/fully built be passable is 
unnecessary, as well as having them built right under you

Fix it back like it was

The walking through was fixed about a day ago. I'm trying to eliminate the direction
system in general so that I can remove the confusing and unnecessary different
movement types entirely - if you can think of a way to build walls other than
building them under you that wouldn't require using the "change direction" movement
type in some situations, I'm all ears!

Perhaps have it be like the throw system; click on 'build wall' in the metal 
options, then click one the square you want to build it (withink one tile of course).
Ooh, that's a good idea. Thanks!
